boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented annual campus and student-organization traditions at Monmouth University.

cards.title: Weeks of Welcome
cards.subtitle: First five weeks of the fall semester
cards.notes: Use the opening weeks to attend programs designed to build community, make connections, and learn how to navigate campus.
cards.short_summary: A five-week fall welcome series for incoming students.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth identifies Weeks of Welcome as a traditional program held during the first five weeks of the fall semester.
cards.access_notes: Check the University event listing for individual program details.

cards.title: Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Campus visit tradition
cards.notes: Invite family or other loved ones to campus and use the weekend to share your routines and introduce them to Monmouth life.
cards.short_summary: A campus occasion for students and loved ones to connect.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth lists Family Weekend among its traditional programs and describes it as a time for students to invite loved ones to campus.
cards.access_notes: See the University event listing when dates and program details are announced.

cards.title: Homecoming and Reunion Weekend
cards.subtitle: Fall campus celebration
cards.notes: Plan around the reunion programming and campus gathering, then look for the current schedule of alumni, family, food, and game activities.
cards.short_summary: A fall tradition connecting current students with alumni and families.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth lists Homecoming and Reunion Weekend as a traditional program; its athletics history describes Homecoming as a fall, football-centered celebration.
cards.access_notes: Consult the current Homecoming and Reunion Weekend schedule for event-specific access.

cards.title: SpringFest
cards.subtitle: Annual end-of-year celebration
cards.notes: Watch for the yearly theme and join the end-of-semester program’s rides, food trucks, games, performances, and other listed activities.
cards.short_summary: A themed celebration that closes the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth describes SpringFest as its annual end-of-year celebration, with a different theme each year.
cards.access_notes: Review the current SpringFest announcement for date, location, and activity details.

cards.title: Finals Relief
cards.subtitle: Final-exam-period de-stress events
cards.notes: During finals, choose a listed de-stress activity—such as a therapy-dog visit or late-night snack—and build a short break into study time.
cards.short_summary: A finals-period series of stress-management activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth lists Finals Relief as a tradition offering de-stress activities during the final exam period.
cards.access_notes: Individual events vary; verify the current Finals Relief listing before attending.

cards.title: The Big Event
cards.subtitle: SGA community-service tradition
cards.notes: Register through Student Government Association when sign-ups open, then volunteer at an assigned community work site near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth states that SGA hosts The Big Event annually and that it is the University’s largest community-service project.
cards.source_title: Clubs and Organizations Traditions | Student Engagement | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: Registration and work-site assignments are organized by SGA.

cards.title: Winter Ball
cards.subtitle: RHA and SAB’s annual semi-formal at the Great Hall
cards.notes: Follow Residence Hall Association and Student Activities Board announcements, dress for the semi-formal format, and attend at the Great Hall.
cards.short_summary: A yearly student semi-formal held in Monmouth’s Great Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth identifies Winter Ball as a yearly semi-formal hosted by RHA and SAB at the Great Hall.
cards.source_title: Clubs and Organizations Traditions | Student Engagement | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: Check the organizers’ current announcement for attendance requirements.

cards.title: Culture Fest
cards.subtitle: SAB cultural showcase
cards.notes: Attend the Student Activities Board program to experience the participating clubs’ dance, food, and cultural-showcase contributions.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative campus celebration of cultures and traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth states that SAB leads Culture Fest with multiple clubs and organizations, featuring dancing, food, and cultural showcases.
cards.source_title: Clubs and Organizations Traditions | Student Engagement | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: Look for the current Culture Fest listing from Student Engagement or SAB.

cards.title: Ebony Night
cards.subtitle: Black Student Union annual cultural program
cards.notes: Follow Black Student Union announcements for the program, which includes awards, a red-carpet experience, music, and step performances.
cards.short_summary: A BSU-hosted campus night highlighting Black culture.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth identifies Ebony Night as a Black Student Union-hosted event highlighting and unifying Black culture on campus.
cards.source_title: Clubs and Organizations Traditions | Student Engagement | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: Verify the current event announcement for date, venue, and participation details.

cards.title: Founders' Day
cards.subtitle: Annual October convocation
cards.notes: Mark the second Wednesday in October and attend the formal convocation recognizing Monmouth’s founding, scholarship, and honorees.
cards.short_summary: A formal annual ceremony rooted in Monmouth’s 50th anniversary.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth’s athletics history says Founders’ Day began in 1983, became a tradition, and is scheduled annually on the second Wednesday in October.
cards.access_notes: The documented convocation has been held in Pollak Theatre; confirm the current year’s venue and invitation details.
